title: For Your Sake, My People (Namar Jong Phi)
cultural_context: Poignant lyric expressing lifelong dedication to preserving Khasi culture, folklore, and speech, from 'Ka Phawar Beh Sbai'.
lyrics_khasi:
Namar jong phi, ko kur ko kha,
Nga kynud ia kane ka sur,
Nga wad ia ki kyntien
Ba la pynsah ki kpa tymmen;
Wat la ngam don spah ksiar,
Nga don ka dohnud ba ieit
Ia ka ktien u Hynniewtrep
Ba sotti bad ba khuid.

Lada nga thait ha ka lynti,
Phi pynshlur ia nga ban ieng;
Ka kmen jong phi dei ka burom
Jong nga u nongrwai;
Ngin iaid lang sha khmat,
Ban pynriewspah ia ka ri,
Haduh ba ka kti kan thait
Bad ka ktien kan ngap.
lyrics_english:
For your sake, O my clans and kindred,
I chant this heartfelt melody,
Searching out the sacred words
Preserved by our ancient elders;
Though I possess no hoard of gold,
I have a heart overflowing with love
For the mother tongue of the Seven Huts,
Pristine, noble, and pure.

Whenever I grow weary on the road,
Your encouragement bids me rise;
Your joy is the crowning honour
Of me, your humble minstrel;
Together we shall march forward,
To enrich our motherland,
Until this hand can write no more
And my voice falls silent in rest.
